public_rationale: Marcus says the tasks “seem” beyond current AI. Testing whether any April 2024 system could perform any listed task would turn this qualified assessment into a categorical assertion. The surrounding wording preserves the qualification, and no objective standard for scoring it is supplied. The claim therefore cannot fairly receive a factual pass or fail as written.
limitations: This decision does not establish whether the listed tasks were within AI capabilities in April 2024.
No capability evidence search was undertaken after determining that the wording lacks an adjudicable commitment.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As of April 2024, all listed tasks (including Pulitzer-caliber books, Oscar-caliber screenplays, Nobel-caliber discoveries) appear outside the bounds of current AI.

statement.excerpt: All of the above seem outside the bounds of current AI.

our_interpretation: “Current AI” refers to AI capabilities as of April 12, 2024.
“Seem” expresses a tentative assessment of the listed capabilities. It does not commit Marcus to the categorical assertion that no existing system could perform any listed task.

The statement supplies no confidence threshold or standard for deciding when a capability reasonably appears beyond AI. Replacing that uncertainty with a categorical capability test would change the claim.
criteria.support_condition: No objective pass condition can be specified without adding a standard for the speaker’s tentative assessment. Demonstrated limitations could inform that assessment but would not establish that every listed task was beyond AI.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No objective fail condition can be specified without strengthening the wording. A contemporary demonstration could challenge the assessment, but would not automatically contradict the qualified statement as written.

evidence.explanation: The repeated qualification confirms that the passage expresses a tentative assessment. It does not establish whether any listed capability existed.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A clarified commitment specifying whether any successful demonstration would refute the assessment, together with success criteria for the listed tasks, would permit a separate capability assessment.
